name: brtv-play
description: BRTV PLAY — reprodutor de IPTV para Android TV e LG webOS (monorepo)

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm webos:build
scripts.android:apk: pnpm --filter @brtv/android exec npx eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.android:store: pnpm --filter @brtv/android exec npx eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile production
scripts.android:update: pnpm --filter @brtv/android exec npx eas-cli@latest update --channel preview --platform android --auto
